data.title: NZ RegCo Grants TruScreen Waiver From Half-Year Results Announcement
data.description:
TruScreen Group Ltd. ( (NZ:TRU) ) has shared an announcement.

NZ RegCo granted TruScreen a waiver from the NZX requirement to release a half-year results announcement for the six months ended 30 September 2026. The decision followed TruScreen’s application to change its balance date; NZ RegCo cited the company’s substantial Asian business, where Chinese New Year and Ramadan create uncertainty around fourth-quarter revenue recognition and operations, and its core subsidiary and employees being based in Australia.

NZ RegCo said requiring a separate half-year announcement could duplicate reporting and confuse investors. TruScreen remains subject to continuous disclosure obligations, including the immediate release of material information to the market.

data.title: Astra Graphia Announces IDR297 Per-Share 2025 Dividend
data.description:
PT Astra Graphia Tbk ( (ID:ASGR) ) has provided an update.

Astra Graphia Tbk announced a cash dividend of IDR400.587.808.500, equivalent to IDR297 per share, for fiscal year 2025. The Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders approved using part of retained earnings as of 31 December 2025 for the distribution, with net profit attributable to the parent entity reported at IDR270.616.498.521.

The dividend payment is scheduled for 11 December 2026, with shareholders recorded by 2 December 2026 at 16:00 eligible for the distribution. Trading dates begin with the cum-dividend date of 30 November 2026 in the regular and negotiation markets, while applicable taxes and payment procedures will vary according to shareholder status and registration arrangements.

data.title: Ausgold shareholders approve Scheme resolution for OceanaGold acquisition
data.description:
Ausgold Limited ( (AU:AUC) ) has issued an announcement.

Ausgold Limited is the subject of a proposed acquisition by an indirect wholly-owned Australian subsidiary of OceanaGold Corporation through a scheme of arrangement requiring Court approval. At the 27 November 2026 Scheme Meeting, shareholders passed the Scheme resolution, with 99.40% of votes cast and 82.65% of shareholders present and voting in favour; the Scheme remains subject to Court approval and other conditions.

data.title: Madoro Updates Proposed Reverse Takeover and Québec Lithium Property Option
data.description:
Madoro Metals Corp ( (TSE:MDM) ) has provided an announcement.

Madoro Metals and Narrow River Resources continue work on the proposed reverse takeover, including responding to TSXV comments and completing transaction documents and disclosure. Subject to TSXV review and approval, Madoro currently anticipates a shareholder meeting in the first quarter of 2027; the date has not been set, while its annual meeting is scheduled for December 15, 2026.

The proposed non-brokered private placement was revised to up to C$1.45 million through 29 million hard-dollar units priced at C$0.05, each including one share and half a warrant; each whole warrant carries a C$0.08 exercise price for two years. Madoro also agreed to pay C$30,000 by December 31, 2026, to waive remaining exploration commitments and complete its option to acquire 100% of First Green, subject to TSXV approval.

data.title: NPK Announces Early Termination of Treasury-Share Trust Agreement
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from NPK Co., Ltd ( (KR:048830) ).

NPK Co., Ltd. reported its decision to terminate early a KRW 1 billion trust agreement with Samsung Securities for acquiring treasury shares, after completing the planned acquisition. The termination covers 949,324 common shares acquired under the trust, which the filing states will be returned by the trustee and deposited into the company’s securities account; NPK reported 970,662 treasury shares, or 5.18% of issued shares, acquired within the distributable profit limit before termination.
